title: Planning a Trip Around Prayer Obligations
paragraphs: Organizing an extensive multi-country business itinerary, Hilman realized his usual approach of scheduling meetings freely throughout the day would require significant adjustment to accommodate prayer times across several different time zones during a two-week trip.

Rather than treating prayer as something to fit in wherever time allowed, he deliberately blocked specific windows in his calendar before scheduling any client meetings, treating these commitments as equally fixed as his most important professional appointments.

This approach occasionally required declining meeting times that clients initially proposed, conversations that felt uncomfortable given the professional relationships involved, yet none of his clients ultimately objected once alternative times were offered.

Reflecting after the trip, Hilman noted that prioritizing his prayers structurally, rather than hoping to fit them in in reactively, actually made the entire demanding trip feel considerably more manageable and less spiritually depleting than previous journeys.
